subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Breach Notification Laws
description: A short lesson to help you apply Breach Notification Laws.

hook.text: Your data was stolen six months ago. The company only told you last week. That used to be legal.

buildup.text: Breach notification laws require companies to inform affected individuals within a set time after a breach.

discovery.text: All 50 US states have breach notification laws, but timelines and requirements differ wildly.

twist.text: Companies operating nationally must navigate a patchwork of 50 different state notification rules.

climax.text: The US still lacks a single federal breach notification standard. Every state has its own version.

punchline.text: 50 states. 50 notification rules. No federal standard.

quiz.question: How many US states have breach notification laws?
